name: Economics
boundaries: Economics: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Unified resolution of the equity premium puzzle
original_dispositions.reason: The tertiary claim of disagreement and the recorded partial quantitative accounts do not establish a missing capability at the scale of ECO-01 through ECO-10. The historical 6–7 percent figure was not re-verified in a primary source.

original_dispositions.original_title: Complete microfoundations bridging micro and macro with heterogeneity and behavior
original_dispositions.reason: Aggregate restrictions, predictive and welfare-usable bounded rationality, and policy-invariant macro counterfactuals are covered respectively; the IDs are not merged. Fast heterogeneous-agent computation was judged achieved in the first pass.

original_dispositions.original_title: Resolution of the Cambridge capital controversy
original_dispositions.reason: The unresolved questions are judged interpretive and not a new operational capability at the required scale. Capital aggregation is distinct from the demand aggregation of ECO-01.

original_dispositions.original_title: Exact causal mechanism of the Industrial Revolution and later growth divergences
original_dispositions.reason: A historical explanation counts as the ECO-07 breakthrough only when it names a lever that can be registered in advance and then changes sustained TFP growth. A separate ID would duplicate that concept.

The notes describe recent explanations in terms of shocks, samples, and regimes. Closing the correlation is not judged a new principle of capital mobility at the calibration bar; missing international risk-sharing markets remain a symptom inside ECO-06.

original_dispositions.original_title: Unified model of all exchange-rate and purchasing-power-parity puzzles, with reliable currency forecasting
original_dispositions.reason: A cited model proposes to account for major puzzles while allowing near-martingale exchange rates. Reliable week-by-week forecasting is a different, stronger claim that the literature does not establish. Household macro-risk markets remain ECO-06 and regime counterfactuals ECO-08.

original_dispositions.original_title: Predictive micro-founded theory of labor-market volatility and a full resolution of the Shimer puzzle
original_dispositions.reason: The notes describe competing quantitative accounts and judge the remaining calibration and modeling dispute ordinary science. New stabilization-regime counterfactuals remain ECO-08. The historical 10× figure is not Shimer’s abstract comparison.
The descriptive money-creation mechanism is recorded as achieved; the unachieved part is a national payments and credit system without run-prone private debt that preserves credit through stress.

original_dispositions.original_title: Practical non-dictatorial social welfare function and a comprehensive welfare metric
original_dispositions.reason: The tested preference-respecting interpersonal metric is the economically relevant escape from the stated ordinal barrier. A single new ballot rule remains rejected.

original_dispositions.original_title: Scalable mechanism design for global public goods
original_dispositions.reason: The match is direct: incentive-compatible provision among parties who can refuse, without a world tax authority. The government-tax mechanism is a narrower case.

reconciliation_change_log.change: IDs ECO-01 through ECO-10 are unchanged in identity. No concept was deleted, replaced, or merged. No ECO-11 or later ID was added.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical list was treated as candidate material; its five source claims were checked and do not support the package as written.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Named Keenan and Kim’s March 2026 preprint, revised May 2026.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Its abstract presents a modeling caveat about uniqueness and stability, not a replacement for Debreu’s theorem or an empirically validated aggregate law. Access was abstract only.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Named the transportability-review authors, retained the 17/20 randomized-trial figure, and used the Vivalt DOI and IDEAS record.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The figures were reconfirmed in abstracts; the earlier Oxford article number 5912347 was not confirmed.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Stated Arrow’s ordinal barrier using the Stanford Encyclopedia statement and Arrow quotation.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The missing object remains a tested interpersonal metric; a new voting rule remains outside the concept.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Flagged the Backus–Kehoe–Kydland consumption-correlation and equity-home-bias puzzles as symptoms.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The same missing markets would have to move those symptoms; exchange-rate models address a different object.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Clarified that an Industrial Revolution account counts only if it is a manipulable, prospectively predictive growth law; added Geruso–Spears and Weil as population context.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Weil’s 8.7 percent consumption comparison is a level calculation, not a completed TFP lever.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Recorded McLeay, Radia, and Thomas’s description of deposit creation as achieved and corrected the narrow-banking citation to Stephen Williamson, DOI 10.1016/j.jet.2024.105859.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The missing object remains a demonstrated national system supplying liquidity and credit without run-prone private debt. The earlier DOI 10.1016/j.jet.2024.105799 was wrong and is withdrawn.
